name: Visiting Dean from Edith Cowan University, Australia

content.title: Visiting Dean from Edith Cowan University, Australia
content.summary: Professor Di Twigg from Edith Cowan University, Australia visits SONAM-Nairobi

media.caption: Professor Di Twigg Presenting to the group
media.alt: Visiting Dean from Edith Cowan University, Australia

content.text: Professor Di Twigg, Executive Dean, School of Nursing and Midwifery at Edith Cowan University, Australia visited SONAM-Nairobi on July 24, 2017. Her presentation was entitled Can Research Assist in Finding Solutions to the Health Issues Facing our Communities?

Professor Twigg discussed the research capacity of the School's Centre for Nursing and Midwifery Health Services Research, which has three research programmes: safety and quality in healthcare; improving outcomes for adults with chronic health conditions; and childbearing, children and young people. Professor Twigg highlighted research outcomes from publications authored by some of her faculty. One study discussed the importance of health promotion among nurses and midwives, and another focused on caregivers working closely with childbearing women to meet desired birth plans. It was interesting to learn about the implications this research had for practice, including their potential positive health impact in Kenya as well as Australia. The presentation was insightful and provided an opportunity for SONAM faculty to share ideas and common interests, and discuss how research can transform health in Kenya. It also demonstrated the importance of engaging with other universities to build collaborative relationships to support SONAM's nursing programmes and faculty development in academia, research and publication output.
